ModMetaData.name: Iris Texture Budget
ModMetaData.author: Iris local performance project
ModMetaData.description:
Local texture-memory budget for this RimWorld installation.
It reduces retained texture memory while assets load. DDS textures start directly at a safe lower mip level whenever possible; irregular textures are resampled only when necessary and reused through a source-validated persistent cache. The default balanced profile keeps UI textures up to 1024 px, general textures up to 512 px, and pawn/apparel textures up to 256 px.
Do not enable together with Image Opt. This mod does not alter Workshop files or saves.
